situation: I'm Daniel Carter and my son Eli (8C) got a zero on his science project for being 'late', but Google Classroom shows he submitted it at 7:40pm on Sunday 20 September, before the Monday deadline; I have a screenshot. Teacher is Mr Barnes.
reply: Hi Mr Barnes, I'm Eli Carter's dad (8C). Eli's science project was marked late with a zero, but Google Classroom shows he submitted it at 7:40pm on Sunday 20 September, before the Monday deadline; screenshot attached. Could you take a look and let me know if I've missed something? Thanks for checking, Daniel Carter
note: A question, not a verdict: the timestamp does the arguing, and 'if I've missed something' lets him fix it without losing face.

situation: 我是刘可欣的妈妈，女儿在三年级二班，最近每天晚上写数学作业写到十点，一边写一边哭，说课上的两位数乘法听不懂，已经两周了。我们在家每天陪她练15分钟口算。班主任兼数学老师是张老师。
reply: 张老师您好，我是三年级二班刘可欣的妈妈。可欣最近两周数学作业经常写到晚上十点，边写边哭，说两位数乘法课上没太听懂。想问问您在课堂上有没有观察到类似的情况？我们在家每天陪她练15分钟口算。您这周哪天方便通个电话？放学后或中午都可以。谢谢您！
note: 只说看到的事实，再问老师看到了什么，不先下结论说作业太多。

situation: I'm Grace Kim. I emailed my son Noah's 4th-grade teacher, Ms Rivera, on Sept 14 and Sept 21 about a kid shoving him in the bus line since early September, twice leaving a bruise on his arm. No reply either time, and it's still happening. I want to ask the assistant principal, Mr Grant, to meet this week.
reply:
Dear Mr Grant,
I'm writing about my son Noah Kim (4th grade, Ms Rivera's class). Since early September another student has been shoving him in the bus line after school, twice leaving a bruise on his arm. I emailed Ms Rivera on 14 and 21 September (copies below) and haven't heard back, and it's still happening. Could you let me know the school's next steps, and when we could meet this week?
Thank you,
Grace Kim
note: Escalate with dates and copies, no criticism of the teacher. If Noah is being hurt again, contact the safeguarding lead the same day.

situation: I'm the dad of Nora (Grade 5, Ms. Kowalski's class), who was just diagnosed with ADHD. She says she can't focus in her seat by the window and keeps getting in trouble for unfinished work. At home we've started breaking homework into 15-minute blocks with short breaks, which helps. I'm free after 3:30 any day. I'd like to talk to the teacher before the November conferences.
reply: Hi Ms. Kowalski, I'm Nora's dad. Nora was recently diagnosed with ADHD, and she's told us she finds it hard to focus in her seat by the window and often doesn't finish classwork. I'd really like to hear what you've seen in class before we assume anything. At home we've started breaking homework into 15-minute blocks with short breaks, which seems to help. Could we meet for 20 minutes in the next couple of weeks? I'm free after 3:30 any day, or happy to do a call. Thank you.
note: Share the diagnosis only as far as it helps the teacher, then ask what she sees instead of prescribing a seat change in the first message.

situation: I'm Emi Tanaka. My son Kai (10B) got a Saturday detention for 'defiance' after refusing to take his hoodie off in class on Monday. He has an eczema flare on his arms and was embarrassed. Head of year is Mr Okafor; detention is this Saturday, Oct 3. His GP can write a note, and I'm free any afternoon this week.
reply: Dear Mr Okafor, I'm Kai Tanaka's mum (10B). Kai has a Saturday detention on 3 October for refusing to take off his hoodie in class on Monday. He has an eczema flare on his arms at the moment and was embarrassed to show it, which he should have explained rather than just refusing. Could the detention be reconsidered, and could he wear a plain long-sleeved top until it clears? I can send a note from his GP, and I'm free to talk any afternoon this week. Thank you, Emi Tanaka
note: Disagreeing with a sanction: give the missing fact, concede Kai's part, and ask for a decision plus a practical fix.

situation: I emailed my daughter Mia's Grade 7 teacher, Mr. Hale, that she's spending 3 hours a night on homework. He replied the assignments are designed for 45 minutes and maybe she's distracted at home. I don't want a fight.
reply: Thanks for getting back to me so quickly, Mr. Hale, that's useful to know, 45 minutes is a lot less than we're seeing. This week I'll keep a simple log of what Mia works on and for how long, with her phone in the kitchen, and send it to you on Friday. If it's still well over, could we meet for 15 minutes next week to see where she's getting stuck?
note: Don't argue with the implied criticism; turn it into shared evidence and a small next step.

situation: 我是王乐乐的妈妈，儿子乐乐在四年级三班，10月15号、16号（周四周五）要回老家参加外婆八十大寿，得请两天假。班主任是李老师。想提前说一声，也问问落下的功课怎么补。
reply: 李老师您好，我是四年级三班王乐乐的妈妈。乐乐外婆过八十大寿，我们要回老家一趟，想给他请10月15日周四和16日周五两天假，19日周一正常上学。想问一下这两天的作业和课堂内容，能不能麻烦您提前告诉我们，或者让同桌帮忙记一下？我们会在路上带着他补上。给您添麻烦了，谢谢！
note: 计划中的请假要提前说，给出准确日期和返校日，再主动问怎么补课，老师更好安排。

situation: I'm Tom Reid (tom.reid@example.com). My ex and I separated over the summer and our son Sam (Year 3, Mr Doyle's class) now lives with me Monday to Wednesday; he seems to be coping well, and we keep homework and bedtimes the same in both homes. All the school emails and reading-record notes go only to his mum. I want to be copied in, and give the teacher a heads-up.
reply: Hi Mr Doyle, I'm Sam's dad, from your Year 3 class. Sam's mum and I separated over the summer, and Sam is now with me Monday to Wednesday and with her the rest of the week. Could you add me to the class emails and reading-record notes, at tom.reid@example.com, so both homes stay in the loop? He seems to be handling it well, and we're keeping homework and bedtimes the same at both houses. If you notice anything in class, I'd really appreciate hearing about it. Thanks, Tom Reid
note: Family change: facts only, no blame on the other parent, one practical ask, and an open door for the teacher to share what he sees.

situation: I'm Laura Kemp, free after 3:30 most days. My son Owen's teacher, Ms. Delgado (Grade 2), called and then emailed me yesterday: Owen pushed a classmate off the slide at recess and the boy scraped his knee. Owen says the other kid pushed him first, but agrees pushing is wrong and has written the boy a sorry note. I want to reply to her email without sounding defensive.
reply:
Hi Ms. Delgado, thank you for calling me yesterday about recess. We talked with Owen last night. He says the other boy pushed him first, and he also agrees that pushing someone off the slide is never okay; he's written a short sorry note he'd like to give him. If you saw anything that would help us understand what happened, I'd be grateful to hear it. Could we have a quick call this week about what Owen should do next time he's upset at recess? I'm free after 3:30 any day.
Thanks,
Laura Kemp
note: When your child is the one in trouble, don't argue the facts: show what you're doing at home, ask what the teacher saw, and look ahead.

situation: I'm Ava's mum and free any day after 4pm. My daughter Ava (Year 9, 9R) was moved from top set maths to set 2 this week. She's upset, mostly because nobody told her why. Her maths teacher is Mr Singh. I want to ask about it without sounding like I'm demanding she be moved back.
reply: Hi Mr Singh, I'm Ava's mum (9R). Ava told me she's moved from set 1 to set 2 in maths this week, and she's quite upset, mainly because she isn't sure why. Could you tell me what the move was based on, and what she'd need to show to move back up? We're happy to work on it at home. I can do a call any day after 4pm this week. Thank you.
note: Question a placement by asking what it was based on and what the route back looks like, not by asking for a reversal.

situation: I'm Rachel Grant (07700 900 461). My daughter Maya Grant (Year 9), very distressed, showed me a class group chat where two classmates shared an edited photo of her with nasty captions. It started Sunday night and has been screenshotted into other chats. We've saved copies I can send today, reported the posts to the app, and she's left the chat for now. The school's safeguarding lead is Mrs Ellis.
reply: Dear Mrs Ellis, I'm writing with a safeguarding concern about my daughter, Maya Grant, in Year 9. Since Sunday evening an edited photo of Maya with unkind captions has been shared in a class group chat and screenshotted into other chats; I've saved copies and can send them today. Maya is very distressed. Could you let me know the school's process, and could we speak today or tomorrow? At home we've reported the posts to the app and she's off the chat for now. I'm on 07700 900 461 all day. Thank you, Rachel Grant
note: Online bullying goes straight to the safeguarding lead: dates, evidence on offer, a question about process and a prompt time frame, without naming the other children yet.

situation: I'm Ben Price, free after 4pm. My son Jonah (5C, Ms Carter's class) keeps saying he finishes his maths work early and then gets bored, and he's been told off twice this month for chatting. He loves the puzzle maths we do at weekends. I don't want to come across as the pushy 'my kid is gifted' parent.
reply: Hi Ms Carter, I'm Jonah's dad (5C). Jonah has mentioned a few times this month that he often finishes his maths early and isn't sure what to do next, and I suspect that's when the chatting happens. Have you noticed the same thing? If so, could there be an extension task he moves on to when he's done? At home we do a bit of puzzle maths at weekends, which he loves. I'm free for a quick call after 4pm any day. Thanks, Ben Price
note: Ask what she sees before proposing a fix, and own the chatting rather than excusing it.

situation: 我是陈浩的妈妈，儿子刚上一年级（2）班，对花生严重过敏，医生说一点点也可能引起严重反应，开了肾上腺素笔，放在他书包侧袋里，家里有医院证明和用法说明。班主任是周老师，听说下周学校组织秋游还会发零食，我可以单独给他备零食，也想当面教老师怎么用笔。
reply: 周老师您好，我是一年级（2）班陈浩的妈妈。浩浩对花生严重过敏，医生说哪怕一点点也可能引起严重反应，他的肾上腺素笔放在书包侧袋里，医院证明和用法说明我明天让他带给您。听说下周秋游会发零食，想问一下学校对过敏的孩子有没有固定的处理流程？我可以单独给他准备一份零食。您哪天放学后方便，我当面跟您演示一下笔怎么用。谢谢您！
note: 健康安全的事要具体：过敏原、严重程度、药放在哪，再问学校的流程，并主动分担；万一在校出现过敏反应，按医嘱用笔并立即拨打120。

situation: 我是林朵朵的妈妈，女儿在五年级（3）班，学校下个月去杭州研学三天，费用1680元，这周五前要交。我最近失业了，一下子拿不出来，但不想让孩子知道，也不想在家长群里问。班主任是吴老师。
reply: 吴老师您好，我是五年级（3）班林朵朵的妈妈。想私下跟您了解一下，这次杭州研学的1680元，学校有没有分期交或者困难补助的办法？我家最近情况有些变化，一次交齐有点困难，但很希望朵朵能去。这件事麻烦您先不要跟孩子提。您方便的时候回我一下就好，谢谢您！
note: 费用的事私下问，只问学校有没有办法，不必解释家里的细节，更不要在群里问。

situation: Je suis Claire Moreau, disponible tous les jours après 16 h 30. Ma fille Inès (CM1) m'a raconté que sa maîtresse, Mme Lefèvre, a dit devant toute la classe que son exposé était « nul ». Depuis, Inès ne veut plus aller à l'école le matin. Je veux en parler sans attaquer l'enseignante.
reply: Bonjour Madame Lefèvre, je suis la maman d'Inès (CM1). Inès est rentrée très touchée après son exposé : elle m'a dit que vous l'aviez trouvé « nul » devant la classe, et depuis elle a du mal à partir à l'école le matin. Je sais que je n'ai que sa version, alors j'aimerais savoir comment vous avez vécu ce moment. Pourriez-vous m'accorder un quart d'heure cette semaine ? Je suis disponible tous les jours après 16 h 30. Merci beaucoup, Claire Moreau
note: Quand le souci vient de l'enseignante : les faits tels que l'enfant les raconte, la question plutôt que le verdict, et pas la direction en copie.

situation: I'm Juliana Souza. We moved from Brazil to Leeds in September. Our son Davi (Year 6, Miss Hart's class) speaks only a little English and says he eats lunch alone most days. He loves football and drawing, and we read an English picture book with him every night.
reply: Hi Miss Hart, I'm Davi Souza's mum (Year 6). We moved here from Brazil in September, and Davi is still learning English. He tells me he eats lunch on his own most days. He loves football and drawing, which might be an easy way for him to join in with other children. Could you tell me how the school usually supports children who are new to English, and could we meet for 15 minutes one afternoon? At home we read an English picture book together every night. Thank you, Juliana Souza
note: New arrival: share what helps the child, ask about the school's usual support rather than prescribing it.

situation: I'm Samira Rahman. My son Yusuf (7L, form tutor Ms Lawson) will fast for Ramadan for the first time this coming February. He's proud and a bit nervous about it. He has PE on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and we're doing a few practice fasts at weekends so he knows how he feels. I want to ask early how the school handles it.
reply: Hi Ms Lawson, I'm Yusuf Rahman's mum (7L). Yusuf will be fasting during Ramadan for the first time this coming February, and he's proud and a little nervous about it. He has PE on Tuesdays and Thursdays, so I wanted to ask early how the school usually supports pupils who are fasting, for example with PE and where he can go at lunchtime. At home we're doing a few practice fasts at weekends so he knows how he feels. Could you let me know, or point me to the right person? Thank you, Samira Rahman
note: Asking months ahead, and asking about the school's usual approach rather than prescribing one, makes it an easy yes.

situation: I'm Ben's mum. My dad died on Sunday, and I'm free to talk any day after school. My son Ben (Year 4, Mrs Patel's class) was really close to his grandad, who picked him up from school every Wednesday. The funeral is Thursday 8 October and Ben will be off that day. He's been quiet and teary at home, and we've been talking about Grandad at bedtime.
reply: Dear Mrs Patel, I'm Ben's mum, from your Year 4 class. I wanted to let you know that Ben's grandad, my dad, died on Sunday; he was the one who picked Ben up every Wednesday, and they were very close. Ben has been quiet and teary at home, and we're talking about Grandad at bedtime, so he may have wobbly moments in class too. Could you let me know if you notice anything? He'll be off on Thursday 8 October for the funeral. Thank you, and I'm happy to talk any day after school.
note: A heads-up with one small ask, not a request for special treatment; the teacher can take it from there.

situation: 我是刘小雨的妈妈，女儿读三年级二班，上周五查出近视，大约200度，眼镜配了但要两周左右才能拿到。她说坐在第六排看不清黑板，这几天抄题老抄错。在家我们已经把她用平板的时间减到每天半小时。班主任是王老师。
reply: 王老师您好，我是三（2）班刘小雨的妈妈。小雨上周五查出近视，大约200度，眼镜已经配了，但要两周左右才能拿到。她说坐在第六排看不清黑板，这几天抄题老抄错。这两周能不能麻烦您临时让她坐到前面几排？家里我们已经把她用平板的时间减到每天半小时了。谢谢您，有什么需要随时联系我。
note: 一个具体、有期限的小请求，老师最容易马上答应；说明是临时的，也不会显得在挑座位。

situation: 我是周子墨的爸爸，儿子在一年级（4）班，班主任是赵老师。学校公众号上周发运动会推文，用了子墨一张正脸特写。我们家一直不在公开网络上发孩子正脸照片，班级群里发没关系，想请老师以后对外发布时帮忙避开他的正脸。
reply: 赵老师您好，我是一年级（4）班周子墨的爸爸。谢谢您平时在班级群里发孩子们的照片，我们看得很开心，群里发完全没问题。有个小请求：我们家一直不在公开网络上发孩子的正脸照片，上周学校公众号的运动会推文里用了子墨一张正脸特写。以后公众号这类对外发布的内容，能不能麻烦您帮忙避开他的正脸，或者打个码？给您添麻烦了，谢谢您！
note: 只提一件事、只提以后；已经发出的那篇要不要改，等老师回复后再商量。

situation: I'm Priya's mum, free after 4pm. My daughter Priya (Year 11) got a note from her English teacher, Ms Grant, saying her Macbeth essay 'appears AI-generated' and will get a zero unless she rewrites it. Priya wrote it herself over three evenings in Google Docs, and the version history shows every draft. I want to ask for a chance to show that without accusing the teacher.
reply: Dear Ms Grant, I'm Priya's mum, from your Year 11 English class. Priya showed me your note that her Macbeth essay appears AI-generated. She tells me she wrote it herself over three evenings in Google Docs, and the version history shows each draft. Before the mark is decided, could she walk you through that history, or talk you through her argument in person? I understand why teachers need to check, and we're happy to do whatever helps. I'm free after 4pm any day this week if a call would be useful.
note: Offer the evidence and a way to verify it; do not argue about AI detectors in the first message.

situation: I'm Lily's mum and do pick-up every day. My daughter Lily (Year 2, Mrs Evans' class) has come home starving most days for two weeks, and her lunchbox comes back mostly full. She says they get about 15 minutes to eat before being sent out to play and the boxes are collected. We've already started packing smaller, easier food.
reply: Dear Mrs Evans, I'm Lily's mum, from your Year 2 class. For about two weeks Lily has been coming home very hungry, and her lunchbox comes back mostly full on most days. She tells me they get about 15 minutes to eat before going out to play, and we've started packing smaller, easier food at home. Could you let me know how lunchtime usually works, and whether you've noticed anything? Thank you, and I'm happy to chat at pick-up any day this week.
note: Ask how lunchtime works before assuming the 15 minutes is policy; the lunch staff, not the teacher, may be the ones to fix it.

situation: 我是王建国，孙子王浩然上五年级（1）班，他爸妈都在深圳打工，平时是我带他。这学期他数学单元测验从八十多分掉到了六十分，作业我辅导不了，挺着急。班主任兼数学老师是陈老师，孩子爸爸的手机是13800000005。
reply: 陈老师您好，我是五年级（1）班王浩然的爷爷王建国。浩然爸妈都在深圳打工，平时是我带他。这学期他数学单元测验从八十多分降到了六十分，作业我辅导不了，心里挺着急。想问问您课堂上有没有看到他哪里跟不上？您方便的话，这周哪天放学后我去学校找您谈十分钟。孩子爸爸的手机是13800000005，有事也可以直接找他，我们一家都会配合。谢谢您！
note: 监护人不是父母时，先说清自己是谁、平时谁管孩子，再给老师一个能联系到父母的方式。

situation: I'm Kate Walsh. My son Theo (Year 8, form tutor Mr Hughes) has had stomach aches on most school mornings for three weeks and has missed four days. Our GP found no physical cause and thinks it may be anxiety; Theo says the busy corridors between lessons and the packed canteen are the worst part. At home we've started walking to school together in the mornings.
reply: Dear Mr Hughes, I'm Theo Walsh's mum (Year 8). For about three weeks Theo has had stomach aches on most school mornings, and he has missed four days. Our GP found no physical cause and thinks it may be anxiety; Theo says the busy corridors between lessons and the packed canteen are the hardest part. Have you noticed anything in school? Could we meet this week or next, with anyone from the pastoral team you think should be there? At home we've started walking to school together in the mornings. Thank you, Kate Walsh
note: Facts and the GP's view, then ask what school sees and how it supports pupils; if Theo ever talks about harming himself, contact the GP, a crisis line or emergency services straight away.

situation: I'm Hannah Cole. On 25 September the family court made an order that my son Jack's father, Liam, must not collect Jack (Year 3, Miss Reed's class) from school or contact him there, but Liam is still on the school's pick-up list. From now on only I or my sister, Beth Cole, should collect Jack; the safeguarding lead is Mr Ford, and my number is 07700 900 233.
reply: Dear Mr Ford, I'm writing with a safeguarding matter about my son, Jack Cole, in Miss Reed's Year 3 class. On 25 September the family court made an order that Jack's father, Liam, must not collect Jack from school or contact him there; I'll bring a copy to the office this morning. Liam is still on Jack's pick-up list, so please remove him: from now on only I or my sister, Beth Cole, will collect Jack. Could you confirm today that the list has been updated, and let me know what the school will do if he arrives? I'm on 07700 900 233 all day. Thank you, Hannah Cole
note: Lead with safeguarding and the order, give the school a copy and one practical change; if he turns up and anyone feels unsafe, call emergency services, and a domestic abuse support service can help with a safety plan.

situation: 我是糖糖的妈妈，每天放学都去接她。女儿在阳光幼儿园中班，班主任是孙老师。这周一和周三晚上给她洗澡时，我发现她胳膊上各有一个牙印，她说是班上同一个小朋友咬的。两次老师都没跟我说，我也不知道当时是什么情况。
reply: 孙老师您好，我是中班糖糖的妈妈。这周一和周三晚上给糖糖洗澡时，我发现她胳膊上各有一个牙印，她说是班上一个小朋友咬的。我只听了孩子的说法，想问问您当时有没有注意到是怎么回事？另外想拜托您，以后孩子在园里磕了碰了，哪怕是小伤，也请当天跟我说一声，我们在家好配合。每天放学我都来接，您方便时跟我聊几句就好。谢谢您！
note: 只说看到的牙印和孩子的说法，不点另一个孩子的名字；先问老师看到了什么，再提一个以后能做到的请求。

situation: I'm Mateo's mum. The school portal shows my son Mateo (Year 10, history teacher Mrs Okoye) has six missing history assignments since early September, though he's told me every night his homework was done. We've talked, and from this week he does homework at the kitchen table before any screen time. I want to know what to prioritise and whether there's a deadline to catch up; I'm free afternoons.
reply: Dear Mrs Okoye, I'm Mateo's mum, from your Year 10 history class. I've just seen on the school portal that Mateo has six missing history assignments since early September, which I hadn't realised. We've talked about it, and from this week he does his homework at the kitchen table before any screen time. Could you let me know which pieces he should prioritise, and whether there's a deadline for catching up? Thank you, and I'm happy to talk by phone any afternoon.
note: When your child is the problem, skip the excuses: show what's changed at home and ask the teacher for the plan.

situation: I'm Marta Silva. I'm Deaf and use BSL, and parents' evening for my son Rafael (Year 5, Mr Clarke's class) is on Tuesday 13 October, with 5-minute face-to-face slots. I'd like the school to book a BSL interpreter, or if not, to do it by typed chat on a laptop in a longer slot at the end; email is the best way to reach me.
reply: Dear Mr Clarke, I'm Rafael Silva's mum, from your Year 5 class. I'm Deaf and use BSL, and I'd really like to take a full part in parents' evening on Tuesday 13 October. Could the school book a BSL interpreter for our slot? If that isn't possible, could we talk by typed chat on a laptop, perhaps in a longer slot at the end of the evening? Email is the best way to reach me. Thank you, Marta Silva
note: When the parent needs the adjustment, ask early, offer a fallback, and say which channel works for you.

situation: 我是何一鸣的妈妈，他在二年级（3）班，班主任钱老师要求家长每天晚上9点前检查数学作业、签字，并拍照在班级群里打卡。我在医院上夜班，每周一、三、五晚上不在家，那几晚是外婆带他，外婆没法帮他检查作业。我早上7点半下班到家，孩子8点10分出门上学。
reply: 钱老师您好，我是二年级（3）班何一鸣的妈妈。我在医院上夜班，每周一、三、五晚上不在家，那几晚是外婆在家带一鸣，她没法帮他检查作业。想跟您商量一下：这三天的作业，能不能由我第二天早上7点半下班到家后检查、签字，8点前在群里补打卡？其他几天我都会在晚上9点前按时完成。给您添麻烦了，谢谢您！
note: 做不到老师的要求时，给一个具体、自己做得到的替代办法，比解释难处更容易被同意。

situation: I'm Dawn Price. My daughter Ellie (Year 10) was assessed by an educational psychologist in September and diagnosed with dyslexia; the report recommends extra time in exams. Her mocks are in December, and I want to ask the school's SENCO, Mrs Hall, what the process is. At home she uses a coloured overlay for reading, which helps, and I work from home on Mondays and Fridays.
reply: Dear Mrs Hall, I'm Ellie Price's mum (Year 10). Ellie was assessed by an educational psychologist in September and diagnosed with dyslexia, and the report, attached, recommends extra time in exams. With her mocks coming up in December, could you let me know what the school's process is for exam arrangements, and whether there's anything you need from us before then? At home she uses a coloured overlay for reading, which seems to help. I'm happy to meet or talk on a Monday or Friday, when I work from home. Thank you, Dawn Price
note: Ask about the school's process and timing rather than stating what she's entitled to; whether a private report is accepted varies, so check.

situation: 儿子李子轩在初二（5）班，班主任孙老师每次月考后都会在家长群里发全班成绩排名表。这次他排第38名（全班45人），他说有同学拿排名开他玩笑，这两天早上都说不想去学校。我们在家每周日晚上跟他一起订下一周的学习计划。
reply: 孙老师您好，我是初二（5）班李子轩的家长。想跟您商量一件小事：这次月考排名在家长群里发出来后，子轩说有同学拿排名开他玩笑，这两天早上都说不想去学校。以后的成绩，能不能考虑私下发给每位家长，各家只看自己孩子的分数和名次？我们在家每周日晚上都会跟他一起订下一周的学习计划，会继续配合学校。您方便的时候回我一下就好，谢谢您！
note: 只提一件事，请求放在“以后”，不评价老师的做法；孩子如果持续不想上学或情绪明显低落，及时再找老师，必要时请学校心理老师介入或看医生。

situation: 小学4年の息子の佐藤健太が9月30日に自転車で転んで右足首を骨折し、医師から3週間は松葉づえが必要と言われました。教室は3階で、10月5日（月）から登校させたいです。担任は山田先生で、朝の登校は母の私が車で送ります。
reply: 山田先生、いつもお世話になっております。4年生の佐藤健太の母です。健太が9月30日に自転車で転んで右足首を骨折し、医師から3週間は松葉づえが必要と言われました。10月5日（月）から登校させたいのですが、教室が3階のため、階段の移動や休み時間、体育の時間をどう過ごすか、学校ではどのように対応していただけるかご相談できますでしょうか。朝は私が車で送ります。お忙しいところ恐れ入りますが、ご都合のよい時間にお電話いただけると助かります。
note: 医師の指示は具体的に伝え、配慮の中身は決めつけずに学校の対応を尋ねる形にする。

situation: 我是陈静，女儿黄可可在三年级（1）班。今天下午我跟班主任林老师、学校心理老师谈了可可最近午休被几个女生孤立的事，商定林老师调整她午休的座位，心理老师每周二找她聊一次，10月16日周五再一起碰一次。家里我每天晚上会问问她午休过得怎么样，想发微信把今天定下的事确认一下。
reply: 林老师您好，我是三（1）班黄可可的妈妈陈静。谢谢您和心理老师今天下午抽时间跟我谈可可午休的事。我把商定的几件事整理一下，您看是否准确：一是您这边调整可可午休的座位；二是心理老师每周二找可可聊一次；三是10月16日（周五）我们再一起碰一次，看看效果。家里我每天晚上都会问问她午休过得怎么样，有情况及时跟您说。再次感谢您！
note: 会后当天用文字确认商定的事，语气是核对而不是留证据；以后如果需要再找学校，日期都在这里。

situation: I'm Priti Shah. My son Arjun (Year 6, Mr Bell's class) goes on the three-night residential trip on Monday 12 October. He still sometimes wets the bed at night, which our GP says is common at his age, and he's terrified the other children will find out; he'll pack disposable night pants and a sleeping bag liner he can manage on his own. I'd like the staff to know discreetly, and I'm free after 3:30 any day.
reply: Dear Mr Bell, I'm Arjun Shah's mum, from your Year 6 class. Ahead of the residential on Monday 12 October, I wanted to let you know privately that Arjun still sometimes wets the bed at night; our GP says it's common at his age. He's very worried the other children will find out. He'll pack disposable night pants and a sleeping bag liner he can manage on his own. Could you let me know how staff usually handle this discreetly on trips, and who will know? I'm free after 3:30 any day if a quick chat is easier. Thank you, Priti Shah
note: Share only what staff need, ask about their usual approach rather than prescribing one, and ask who will be told.

situation: I'm Simone Adeyemi. On Wednesday the head of year, Ms Doyle, told my daughter Zara (Year 7) that the beads in her box braids break the uniform policy and must come out by Monday. The policy on the school website says 'hair accessories must be plain and dark', and Zara's beads are small and black; the braids took six hours to put in and she's been upset about it since. I'm free after 4pm any day.
reply: Dear Ms Doyle, I'm Zara Adeyemi's mum (Year 7). Zara told me that on Wednesday you asked her to take the beads out of her braids by Monday, as they break the uniform policy. She's been upset about it, as the braids took six hours to put in. I've read the policy on the school website, which says hair accessories must be plain and dark, and her beads are small and black, so I'd like to understand which part they don't meet. Could we have a quick call before Monday? I'm free after 4pm any day. Thank you, Simone Adeyemi
note: Quote the policy and ask how it applies instead of arguing; if the answer still seems wrong, ask for the school's complaints process in writing.

situation: I'm Noor Haddad, 16, three weeks into Year 12. I want to switch from A-level Chemistry to Psychology: I've been getting E grades in the Chemistry topic tests, I'm hoping to study criminology at university, and my parents agree. I'm emailing the head of sixth form, Mr Brennan, myself, and I'm free in my study periods on Tuesday and Thursday mornings.
reply: Dear Mr Brennan, I'm Noor Haddad in Year 12. I'd like to ask about switching from A-level Chemistry to Psychology. I've been getting E grades in the Chemistry topic tests, and I'm hoping to study criminology at university, so Psychology feels like a better fit; my parents agree with the change. Is it still possible to switch at this point, and if so, what's the process and is there a deadline? I'm free in my study periods on Tuesday and Thursday mornings if it would help to talk. Thank you, Noor
note: When the student writes, the same shape applies: who you are, the facts, a question about the process, and when you're free.

situation: 我是四年级（2）班张一航的妈妈周敏。最近两周有两次放学后一航被留在教室补作业，到5点半才出来，事先没人通知我，我在校门口等了一个多小时，打他电话手表也没接通，急坏了。班主任是黄老师；补作业我理解，家里我们也开始每天睡前检查他的作业，只希望以后留堂能提前在微信上告诉我一声。
reply: 黄老师您好，我是四年级（2）班张一航的妈妈周敏。最近两周一航有两次放学后留在教室补作业，到5点半才出来，我在校门口等了一个多小时，打他电话手表也没接通，当时挺着急的。补作业我完全理解，家里我们也开始每天睡前检查他的作业了。想拜托您，以后如果需要留他，能不能提前在微信上跟我说一声，我好安排接送？谢谢您！
note: 只提一个以后的请求，不追究那两次是谁的疏忽；说清家里在做什么，老师更容易配合。

situation: 我是四年级（1）班林小米的妈妈。小米在学校合唱团，9月因为肺炎请假两周，缺了四次排练，音乐老师吴老师说她不能参加10月23日的区合唱比赛了，小米哭了好几天。她病好后每天在家跟着排练录音练半小时，我工作日下午5点后都方便通电话。
reply: 吴老师您好，我是四年级（1）班林小米的妈妈。小米9月因为肺炎请了两周假，缺了四次排练，我理解比赛前大家要排练整齐，您这样决定一定有您的考虑。想请教一下，这次参赛名单是根据什么定的？如果她在比赛前把进度补上，还有没有机会，比如找个时间让您听她唱一遍？病好以后她每天在家跟着排练录音练半小时。不管结果怎样，都谢谢您。我工作日下午5点后都方便通电话。
note: 对老师的决定有疑问时，先问依据和补救的办法，不要求推翻；孩子的失落在家里接住，不拿来给老师施压。

situation: I'm Hana Brooks. My daughter Ivy is in Year 5, and her class teacher, Mr Daley, has been on long-term leave since mid-September; the class has had four different supply teachers since then. Ivy says her reading record hasn't been signed or her homework marked for about three weeks, and she's started saying school 'doesn't count right now'. I'd like to ask the Year 5 phase leader, Mrs Kaur, how the class is being covered, and I'm free any morning before 9.
reply: Dear Mrs Kaur, I'm Hana Brooks, Ivy's mum, in Mr Daley's Year 5 class. I know the class has had several supply teachers since mid-September, and that can't be easy to arrange. Ivy tells me her reading record hasn't been signed or her homework marked for about three weeks, and she's started saying school 'doesn't count right now'. Could you let me know how the class will be covered for the rest of term, and who Ivy should go to with her reading and homework in the meantime? I'm happy to talk any morning before 9. Thank you, Hana Brooks
note: Ask about the plan, not about why the teacher is away, and don't fault the supply staff, who are working without a handover.

situation: Ich bin Anna Schulz. Meine Zwillinge Mia und Paul sind seit August in der 1. Klasse und wurden auf zwei Klassen verteilt: Mia in die 1a, Paul in die 1b bei Herrn Krüger. Paul weint seit etwa drei Wochen fast jeden Morgen vor der Schule und sagt, er vermisst Mia; zu Hause lassen wir ihn abends erzählen, was in der Schule schön war, und ich kann nachmittags ab 15 Uhr.
reply: Sehr geehrter Herr Krüger, ich bin Anna Schulz, die Mutter von Paul aus der 1b. Paul weint seit etwa drei Wochen fast jeden Morgen vor der Schule und sagt, dass er seine Zwillingsschwester Mia vermisst, die in die 1a geht. Wie erleben Sie ihn im Unterricht und in der Pause? Zu Hause lassen wir ihn abends erzählen, was in der Schule schön war. Hätten Sie in den nächsten Tagen Zeit für ein kurzes Gespräch? Ich kann nachmittags ab 15 Uhr. Vielen Dank, Anna Schulz
note: Nicht gleich einen Klassenwechsel fordern: erst fragen, was der Lehrer beobachtet, dann gemeinsam überlegen, was Paul hilft.
